sloka: एहीदानीं कृतं विद्धि सुकृतं तन्न संशयः ।आगच्छ सौम्य गच्छामः स्वमेव भवनं प्रति ।। ७.२५.१५ ॥
transliteration: ehīdānīṁ kṛtaṁ viddhi sukṛtaṁ tanna saṁśayaḥ ।āgaccha saumya gacchāmaḥ svameva bhavanaṁ prati ।। 7.25.15 ॥

translations.english: Come now, know that what is done is well done, there is no doubt about it; come, O gentle one, let us go to our own abode.
